brief:
Settlers attacked olive harvesters and international solidarity activists in Qasra village, Nablus district, the Ma'an news agency reported. The assault targeted Palestinians engaged in the annual olive harvest alongside foreign supporters present in the area.

Details of casualties or injuries were not immediately available. Qasra has been a flashpoint for settler violence during harvest season, when Palestinian farmers and international observers work in groves near Israeli settlements.
title: Settlers attack olive pickers and solidarity activists in Qasra village
